meta.name: Places & Spaces: Escape to the Country
meta.description:
There’s no place like home, and no channel embraces the interiors, exteriors and everything in between quite like this. From Grand Designs to the entire Escape franchise, all these international hits are now together in one, 24-hour channel.

Shows: Escape to the Country, Grand Designs, Clean It, Fix It, Finest Homes, Great British Railway Journeys
Available on: The Roku Channel, Plex
